notes.title: Edenfall Demo Patch 1.2.2
notes.notes:
After various playtests and feedback I made an update to the current demo, also because it was possible to get stuck towards the end.

[h2]🔹BUGFIXES🔹[/h2]

[list]
[*] when pressing interact with Alkina too long the skilltree instantly closed again
[*] there was a bug opening the skilltree in places where the player didn't even interact with Alkina
[*] raccoon form can now only be aquired when it should be possible
[*] boss fight now only triggers when players have the right quest
[*] wolf tutorial was resetting mid tutorial when transforming on the platform
[*] swapping skilltrees is now working again
[/list]


[h2]🔹CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS🔹[/h2]

[list]
[*] input key for "select enemy" on keyboard is now [b]TAB[/b]
[*] texts are now a bit bigger throughout all widgets
[*] jumping towards walls has been improved and makes climbing easier
[*] thin lines now show the skilltree hierarchy
[*] visual improvements for cleansing and corrupted areas making it less patchy
[*] objects shouldn't stand between camera and skilltree anymore
[/list]

notes.title: Edenfall Demo Patch 1.2.11
notes.notes:
New patch due to player feedback!

[h2]🔹UPDATED CONTROLS🔹[/h2]

I listened to your feedback and updated the controller layout and a few controls:
[list]
[*] transformations are now accessible with the D-Pad and don't require holding two buttons at the same time anymore!
[*] interacting with Alkina is now the same input as interacting with anything else
[*] continuing the dialogue is also executed with the interaction input
[*] input priority is now: continue dialogue -> interact with world objects -> interact with Alkina.
[*] standard attack is now X
[*] target switching with LB (left) and RB (right)
[/list]

This is how the controller layout looks now:

[img]https://iili.io/dyJORuj.png[/img]


[h2]🔹OTHER IMPROVEMENTS🔹[/h2]

[list]
[*] targeting and target-switching is now working properly, also the current target shouldn't be dropped as often.
[*] change of music at chapel is now less aprupt.
[*] image blends to white are not changed to blends for white for various reasons
[*] after camera sequences the camera now just fades back to the player.
[/list]

notes.title: Edenfall Demo 1.2.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
I made a quick hotfix to get rid of a few bugs - mostly were connected to save and loading back into the game.

[h2]🔹NEW LANGUAGE🔹[/h2]

I'm proud to announce that the Edenfall Demo now features Brazilian Portuguese as third possible language to select. Full dialogue and UI support!


[h2]🔹BUGS🔹[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the training quest for human abilities where you could advance in other areas too early
[*] Crystal Fragments now only spawn once and don't spawn again when loading
[*] Locations are now saved properly, don't trigger again when loading and show up inside of the map correctly.
[*] Once the door at the spiders is opened, it stays that way - even when loading.
[*] Monsters won't spawn anymore when the area has been cleansed.
[/list]


[h2]🔹CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS🔹[/h2]

[list]
[*] Monsters spawn only once. Once they have been defeated they won't spawn again, even when loading into the game.
[*] Change of atmosphere into sunset will now be triggered by player location not by quest-progress
[*] Volume on footstep sounds adjusted.
[/list]

notes.title: NEW DEMO IS AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
I am more than thrilled to finally be able to show you the most recent build of the Edenfall Demo. 


[h1]🔹NEW FEATURES🔹[/h1]

[h3]COMBAT SYSTEM OVERHAUL[/h3]

The biggest change is definitely a complete overhaul of the previous combat system:
The core mechanic is now to build up stacks while attacking in different forms and then trigger them for mighty effects.

[list]
[*]There are three combo slots, attacking three times will add one combo point into a slot.
[*]Combo points always have the same color as the form attacked with.
[*]There are tons of possible combos, to find out the effects of different combos take a look at the skilltrees of each form
[/list]
[img]https://iili.io/dbv1FlR.jpg[/img]

Switching animals more regularly will have a big advantage now. While this is still limited inside of the demo, there will be over 30 possibly abilities in the full game!


[h3]SKILLTREE[/h3]

There are brand new skilltrees for each form! Each skilltree has a few unlockable skills already for you to try. We are constantly building and extending these combos so future updates will have more of them!

[img]https://iili.io/dbgrXFs.png[/img]


[h1]🔹IMPROVEMENTS🔹[/h1]

[h3]FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT[/h3]

Edenfall is now perfectly playable with a controller. Therefor all menus and controls have been optimized to work seamlessly with a controller. In the future we also plan to introduce rumble feedback!


[h3]JUMPS[/h3]

Jumps and air control have been improved, also there is a double jump now - making plattforming a real joy! The wolf form's dash-ability is now his standard dodge and it's usability only dependend on stamina.


[h3]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

Corrupted areas got a big upgrade, making them feel even more corrupted and evil - which will have also effect on cleansing these areas!


[h3]PERFORMANCE[/h3]

We heard your feedback from the last demo and tried our best to make overall performance better to make it run also on older machines. 


[h1]🔹FIXES🔹[/h1]

There have been countless fixes since the last demo-version, including but not limited to fixes regarding the combat-tutorials and save and loading system.

Level borders have been improved to prevent players to go OOB easily.
